name: Regulatory Capital & Reporting
description: Capital ratios, risk-weighted assets, leverage, stress capital, and regulatory reports.

dimensions.name: report
dimensions.description: Report name (e.g., FR Y-9C, Call Report, FFIEC 101)

metrics.name: cet1_ratio
metrics.description: Common equity tier 1 capital divided by risk-weighted assets

metrics.name: rwa
metrics.description: Risk-weighted assets at a point in time

metrics.name: cet1_capital
metrics.description: CET1 capital at a point in time

metrics.name: leverage_ratio
metrics.description: Tier 1 capital divided by the leverage exposure measure

metrics.name: capital_buffer_headroom
metrics.description: CET1 ratio minus the requirement including buffers

conventions.rule: Ratios differ under standardized and advanced approaches; name the binding one.
Distinguish as-reported regulatory filings from internal estimates; filings are fixed once submitted.
RWA adds across risk types and portfolios within one approach.

insight_rules.reason: Attribute ratio change via capital and RWA drivers (a capital walk).

caveats.text: Informational analytics only, not a regulatory capital determination.

chart_conventions.rule: Show capital ratio changes as a walk: opening, earnings, distributions, RWA change, other, closing.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
